question: Keyboard shortcut to Save as document in MS Word 2019 is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**F12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **F12** is the keyboard shortcut used to open the "Save As" dialog box in MS Word 2019.
 
• Using the "Save As" option allows the user to save the current document with a new name or to a different location.
 
• This shortcut is particularly useful for quickly saving different versions of the same document without overwriting the original file.
 
• The "Save As" function can also be accessed from the File menu, but using the F12 shortcut speeds up the process significantly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MS Word**

 
 
• Microsoft Word is a word processing software developed by Microsoft, and it is part of the Microsoft Office suite of productivity software.
 
• It is widely used for creating, editing, formatting, and printing text documents.
 
• Word offers various features such as spell check, grammar check, text formatting, image insertion, and more.
 
• It supports different file formats including .doc, .docx, .pdf, .rtf, and others.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts**
 
 
• Keyboard shortcuts are combinations of keys that provide quick access to certain functions within a software program.
 
• They help users perform tasks more efficiently by reducing the need to navigate through menus.
 
• Common shortcuts in MS Word include Ctrl+C (copy), Ctrl+V (paste), Ctrl+S (save), and Ctrl+Z (undo).
 
 
 
• **Save As**
 
 
• The "Save As" function is used to save a document with a new name or in a different location, preserving the original document.
 
• It can be accessed via the File menu or using the F12 keyboard shortcut.
 
• This function is useful for creating different versions or backups of a document.
